description: the removed maxDepth field is config-invalid, and the message gives the layout line that replaces it

violations.message: Field "maxDepth" was removed, and "layout" replaces it. Replace "maxDepth" with "layout": {"default": "deny", "allow": ["root/*/*/*"]}. It allows the same bucket folders as "maxDepth": 3. To allow any bucket folder, remove "maxDepth" and leave "layout" out. buckets.config.json belongs to a human, so an AI agent does not fix this, but stops and shows this error to the human.
